cellNotes.body: Federal picture: 34 C.F.R. Part 106 remains the Title IX athletics baseline. HR 734 would tighten athletics eligibility around sex-separated teams. Source: Congress.gov HR 734 and eCFR Part 106.
California AB 1327 addresses school athletics participation and Title IX equity. Compare with the federal Part 106 athletics baseline.
Texas SB 15 sets interscholastic athletics eligibility by biological sex. It is in force alongside the federal Title IX athletics rules.
